findings.title: Cultivated enclosure and inherited provision
findings.claim: The Garden and entry in 19:60 can be locally seen as a cultivated enclosure: trees screen its ground, provision sustains dense growth, hidden roots extend below sight, and the cultivated whole passes to new occupants as inheritance or grant.
findings.mechanism: The focus Garden noun meets the entry relation and the preceding loss of practice; the following Garden, hiddenness, provision, and inheritance occurrences give those focus carriers a concrete horticultural setting. The two inheritance facets distinguish transfer from former holders and bestowal without a bargain.
findings.reader_payoff: Entry becomes arrival into a living, provisioned enclosure whose visible surface rests on hidden growth and whose possession is handed on, so the focus promise depicts a place rather than only naming a destination.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains repentant believers entering the Garden without injustice. This is a bounded local cultivation image using 19:59-63; it does not redefine every use of Garden, entry, hiddenness, provision, or inheritance and does not assert a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The branch records and all five channel supports are trusted, but the source is a review nomination rather than an adjudicated channel decision; the exact local carrier-trigger contacts therefore remain qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kisileri kendilerine ait paylardan alikoymak veya bu paylari vermemek cekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus no-wronging form carries withholding a person's due or share.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 19:62 supplies an environment in which futile speech is set aside and peace is named instead.
branch_activations.activation: No withheld share meets the speech ecology as the condition for an interaction that does not injure or deprive participants.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus assurance can be felt as a non-depriving order expressed through peaceful speech.
branch_activations.boundary: The outlier extends the focus assurance experientially; it does not redefine the verb beyond due and deprivation.

branch_activations.carrier: The 19:62 discarded-speech occurrence carries the attributed image of speech cast aside as having no account.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The peace occurrence names the positive relation that remains after futile circulation is removed.
branch_activations.activation: Discarded speech meets peace and returns through the focus Garden and no-deprivation assurance, giving the environment a communicative boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What is excluded from the Garden is not only material deprivation but also speech with no constructive account.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an exploratory attributed extension; it does not claim that the focus word lexically means silence or that all excluded speech is identical.

findings.title: Fātiḥa's guided path overlay
findings.claim: The explicitly added Fātiḥa path material adds a bounded movement to 19:60: repentance turns back into order, faith accepts and binds to a guided way, action is lived as worshipful and help-seeking work, righteous quality becomes fitness for blessing, and entry becomes arrival into the way's interior.
findings.mechanism: The external guidance, straight-path, blessing, worship, and help occurrences meet focus repentance, faith, action, righteous quality, and entry carriers. These contacts add a route and posture to the focus's qualifying sequence while returning through its actual words.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus list can be seen as a movement from return through accepted direction and enacted dependence toward entry, while the Garden promise remains fully recoverable as the plain destination.
findings.containment: This overlay uses only the specific contacts in 1:5-1:7. The ordinary focus reading remains unchanged, and the general praise, mercy, judgment, and lordship material in 1:2-1:4 supplies no separate focus-changing delta here; no whole-Fātiḥa thesis is imported.

epistemic.reason: The external ayat's exact root occurrences and the focus branch records are in the packet, but no external connection decision or full context morphology is supplied; the path relation is therefore a bounded qualified overlay.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işin hazır hale gelip düzene girmesi ana kullanımdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus repentance form carries the supplied image of becoming ordered and continuous.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:6 names a straight path as the requested direction.
branch_activations.activation: The straight-path request meets the repentance carrier, giving return an explicit path-shaped contour beyond the native reversal setting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Repentance is locally perceptible as turning back into an ordered way.
branch_activations.boundary: The path contact colors repentance here; it does not redefine repentance as the whole of the Fātiḥa request.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus faith form carries acceptance of a true word or direction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:6 directly requests guidance to the straight path.
branch_activations.activation: Guidance and straight direction meet faith as acceptance, giving the focus belief a concrete way toward which its assent is oriented.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Faith is locally heard as accepting a direction that can be followed.
branch_activations.boundary: The core acceptance remains intact; the overlay adds direction without deciding that this is the only dimension of faith.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus faith form carries the supplied extension of entering and binding oneself to a proclaimed way.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:7 names the path of those receiving favor, placing blessing on the path relation.
branch_activations.activation: The blessed path meets faith as adherence, so belief gains the posture of joining the way toward which the prayer is directed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Faith can be newly seen as binding oneself to the guided, graced path before the focus entry.
branch_activations.boundary: This extension is an external overlay on the focus form; it does not replace the core acceptance facet or assert a complete account of religious faith.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus action form carries deliberate work performed by an acting person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:5 names worship and seeking help as the paired enacted posture.
branch_activations.activation: Worship and help-seeking meet deliberate work, making the focus action locally perceptible as enacted service carried out in dependence rather than as inert qualification.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Good action gains the contour of worshipful work that proceeds with sought assistance.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay adds posture to action; it does not reduce all good work to one ritual form or displace the focus condition.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey ile yöneldiği kişi arasında uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus righteous quality carries a relation of fitness between a thing and the person or destination it approaches.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:7 supplies the path of those who have received favor.
branch_activations.activation: Fitness meets bestowed favor, giving the focus righteous quality the local contour of conduct suited to a graced destination.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Righteous work can be newly perceived as fitting the path of received blessing.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a bounded path contact, not a claim that righteousness earns or controls the blessing.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da şey dışarıdaki bir konum veya durumdan içerideki konum veya duruma geçer.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus entry form carries crossing from an outside position into an interior destination.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa's straight path is named as a way and then specified as the way of those who received favor.
branch_activations.activation: The path carrier meets entry as an interior route, so the focus Garden entry gains a trajectory rather than only a terminal location.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Entry is locally seen as arrival into the guided way's interior, while the Garden remains the named destination.
branch_activations.boundary: The path is an external overlay contact and is not asserted as the focus's sole meaning of entry.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçiş yer, zaman veya iş alanında gerçekleşebilir ve kimi kullanımda azar azar ilerleyen bir süreç olarak sunulur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus entry form carries a transition that can unfold as movement through a place or process.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:6 joins a request for guidance with a named straight path.
branch_activations.activation: Guidance through a path meets entry as a process, making the threshold capable of being read as arrival after directed movement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus entry can be newly felt as the endpoint of being led along a way.
branch_activations.boundary: The process facet is retained only for this external contact and does not turn the focus's future entry into a claim about duration.

friction_notes: The six assigned HFT records are parseable and fully visible, but their reader identity is legacy_unbound; exact focus/context coordinates and roles are retained as attributed evidence, while unresolved context branches remain without invented glosses or facets.
The automatic host basmala 19:0 was reviewed as macro context and supplied no independent carrier-trigger contact that materially changes 19:60, so no basmala finding was retained.

The native 19:59-76 pericope was assessed before the explicit external ayat. The external review retained only the specific 1:5-1:7 path/action contact; the broader 1:2-1:4 praise, mercy, lordship, and judgment material did not add a separate focus-changing relation beyond the native findings.

No focus word alignment is unresolved, and the packet supplies no semantic_obligations entries; therefore no semantic obligation was excluded. All six connection records are landed across the retained findings.
